questions.question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark(?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/960f4aa06b2c46f8cbc3fc43729902c8e4f1ec4e71fed66aff33ddf696aa4041.png]
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Middle figure is rotate 90º anticlockwise in every next figure.

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e3c44bf9e8d4b11ae6c945a6b7c731fcd6d92e98ec81af28d025f156428860.png] is increase by two in every next figure. 

The figure that will complete the series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8250e1d33b6b64f033c419c1ed64ae680a03eada40d28dbfe9b7961b8ce51daa.png] 

Hence, '**option 3**' is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e3c44bf9e8d4b11ae6c945a6b7c731fcd6d92e98ec81af28d025f156428860.png] in option no 2 are not in any corner.

Corners are being followed as per the logic so the correct answer is option 3, where there are 2 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e3c44bf9e8d4b11ae6c945a6b7c731fcd6d92e98ec81af28d025f156428860.png] in the top right corner and 1 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3e3c44bf9e8d4b11ae6c945a6b7c731fcd6d92e98ec81af28d025f156428860.png] in the other 3 corners.

questions.question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87d551d9066a53e0d8089bbf3d3af5147e5aa1aef43f7ec367f078d8cce97b25.png]
questions.solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d7d4f615b4563e659378cbaf3ec2c97dbd36ae1e9662d6e65688e34d7b9e6db.png] 

1) Rectangle - It is shifting in clockwise direction at corners only and with every shift it also rotating vertically and horizontally alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acf35b4cec5e31b9e93ffaf27a02acc3366ee5927c705637252e0a4a3f4c5e23.png] 

2) Square - It is shifting in clockwise direction at the corners only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8aeb16b4b578ffec22b1272da336d63bceb7b1806bde630a9a626366f77e3d1.png] 

3) Circle - It is shifting in clockwise direction at the corners only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/194b19482f35415e6d663c311ac3b574b885f20a9e617b6e9e4b5e42f3723d20.png] 

4) Rhombus - It is shifting in clockwise direction at the corners only and with every shift it also rotating vertically and horizontally alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6850854170923c486a84a6c57c8bce5ee0cbcade5c889ba8ceefc63375a2208a.png] 

5) Triangle - It is not shifting from its position but rotating at same position in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c65f9e8edead1e5bea33b88ea2554bcfffb2912d6a799afef1bee9391cb655f7.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95df0a6c3fa734fdd86ecc24d2c207cc6288b0590df61dfe0d6449d7179511a4.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a3c2ecf3c3888188be95cacb7f5c6410d956a20dface9d0fca39bbc653cb0b7.png]
questions.solution:
Starting from the image at north-west corner and moving in clockwise direction, we see as we move along the figure series, the images keep shifting towards the centre one by one.

So, in the '?' figure, the circle will be at the centre of the image at the centre.

Also, when pentagon shifts to the centre, it is replaced by A, and so on other images are replaced by the next alphabets in the alphabet series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7797f31f3b40266451df6add47221fbf754c025e442cc7f809c6796e95e4e90b.png] 

Hence, '**option 3**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the figure that will come next in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d02dec936f069ae5432a16f7a1a841f687bc7554a6122afa9020eb05f0d8a7c0.png]
questions.solution:
The figure that will come next in the following figure series is shown below:

1) Triangle shift their position downward in next figure then moved upward in next figure and so on.

2) Arrow rotate clockwise one step in second figure, then rotate two step clockwise in third figure, then rotate three step clockwise in fourth figure at last rotate four step clockwise in last figure. 

3) Star rotate anticlockwise one step in second figure, then rotate two step anticlockwise in third figure, then rotate three step anticlockwise in fourth figure at last rotate four step anticlockwise in last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f4041f1da22b5af359c164bc3f1367356641f994bfd6c4519f067dd8455fc48.png] 

Hence, ‘**option 1**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb8526e06fa3d1e62a03218c6ac1d0d2197527372209ac1c88fbf034638fedcf.png]
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82668e1c5730192c08b1b77bade6aa6d7ec5bf5f756256d65f4ec1d4a951514a.png] shifted right bottom corner in second figure then rotate 180º clockwise. Then shifted right bottom corner in third figure then rotate 180º clockwise. At last shifted left bottom corner and rotate 180º clockwise.

2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94a97caff8099073a8df34458985e73cb94c2f9bf13d711c1cdc78779cd92683.png] shifted right left corner in second figure and reverse their position. Then shifted left bottom corner in third figure and reverse their position. At last shifted left upper corner and reverse their position. 

3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9fb156a0aab69e315ad7f63834c2d5a289d02bca50e6e905f74d7d749e02657.png] shifted left bottom corner in second figure and rotate 90° anticlockwise. Then shifted left upper corner in fourth figure and rotate 90° anticlockwise. At last shifted right upper corner in last figure and 90° anticlockwise.

4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a287356bd49fad85fe668eeef1044afb83cb17bd50ce833dd629a14fe781f74.png] shifted left upper corner in second figure and reverse their position. Then shifted right upper corner in third figure and reverse their position. At last shifted right bottom corner and reverse their position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69b07f53327a5240cfcb2bbee22ea27d5aff0dd4e1ab97243a27ccffd4e64cc7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**
